entries.reasoning: The Datavane Platform is a cloud lakehouse and unified analytics platform, matching CloudSpan's definition of a Competing Platform. AtliQ entering into an implementation and referral partnership with Datavane in India and the GCC countries under the Datavane agreement collides with the active CloudSpan exclusivity commitment running until August 31, 2028. The business must decide on this collision.

incomingClauses.quote: Datavane develops and offers the Datavane Lakehouse Platform, a cloud-native lakehouse and unified analytics platform offered on a subscription basis.

"Territory" means the Republic of India; the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council (United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait, Kingdom of Bahrain and Sultanate of Oman); and Europe (the member states of the European Union and the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland).
Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Datavane appoints Partner, and Partner accepts appointment, as a non-exclusive "Datavane Premier Implementation Partner" for the Territory.

Partner shall (a) actively promote the Platform to Prospects in the Territory; (b) register all Prospects in the Partner Portal within five (5) business days of first substantive contact; (c) deliver Partner Services to Datavane Accounts in accordance with Datavane's published implementation methodology; and (d) participate in joint marketing activities as agreed in the annual joint business plan.

For Prospects referred by Partner that purchase a Platform subscription without Partner Services, Datavane shall pay Partner a referral fee of eight percent (8%) of first-year net subscription fees actually received by Datavane.

entries.suggestedChange: Renegotiate Section 1.10 of the Datavane agreement to exclude India and the GCC member states from the Territory until September 1, 2028, or seek consent/waiver from CloudSpan.
entries.impact: Collides with the CloudSpan exclusivity promise, live until August 31, 2028.

clientsAffected: Any existing AtliQ client registered as a Prospect or proposed for the Datavane platform (and their Affiliates)
covenants.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
covenants.impact: Restricts AtliQ and its Affiliates (including AtliQ Inc.) from providing alternative cloud data platform services to any client registered as a Datavane Account for the Term plus 24 months.

clientsAffected: Any existing AtliQ client to whom AtliQ proposes the Datavane Platform
covenants.quote: Where Partner proposes the Platform to an existing client of Partner, Partner shall register such client in the Partner Portal as a Prospect, whereupon such client shall become a Datavane Account.
covenants.impact: Requires AtliQ to register any existing client proposed the Datavane Platform as a Prospect, converting them to a Datavane Account and triggering Section 5.3 restrictions.
